ext_name.description: Manifest name, userscript @name and the settings heading. The brand: keep "AI Reporter" as is and translate only "for". At most 75 characters (Chrome limit).

ext_short_name.description: Manifest short_name, where space is tight. The brand, kept as is. At most 12 characters (Chrome recommendation).

ext_description.message: Labels Steam games whose developers disclose generative AI use, in their own words.
ext_description.description: Manifest description and userscript @description. At most 132 characters (Chrome limit).

ext_action_title.description: Tooltip of the extension's toolbar button, which opens the settings popup. At most 75 characters. Keep "AI Reporter for Steam" as is (see ext_name).

error_unexpected.description: Logged to the browser console when something fails without a more specific message. Short; developers read it, not players.

warn_breaker_opened.message: Steam refused or dropped a request; detection pauses for $seconds$ seconds ($breaker$).
warn_breaker_opened.description: Logged to the browser console when the extension stops asking Steam for a while after an error answer, to avoid being rate-limited. $breaker$ is an internal storage key such as v1:breaker; keep it as is.

notice_breaker_closed.description: Logged to the browser console when the pause after an error answer from Steam is over. $breaker$ is an internal storage key such as v1:breaker; keep it as is.

badge_full.description: Label on search and wishlist rows for a game whose developer disclosed generative AI use on Steam. One line; truncates past about 22 characters. Say "discloses"; never say the game uses AI.

badge_compact.description: Label over game images, also read by screen readers. Keep it as short as the language allows. Say "disclosed"; never say the game uses AI.

badge_tooltip.description: Hover text on a badge. $label$ is the badge label; $notes$ is the developer's text, up to 200 characters, untranslated.

summary_label.description: Label of a row in the game's summary box, under Developer and Publisher. Write it in sentence case; the page shows it in capitals through CSS. Use the same punctuation as the store's own labels there.

summary_value.description: Value of that row, in a violet chip that jumps to the notice. The developer reported AI use on Steam's form; never say the game uses AI. One line; truncates past about 30 characters.

banner_title.description: Heading of the notice on a game's store page.

banner_source.description: Introduces the developer's text, which follows untranslated.

banner_expand.description: Expands the collapsed text of the notice.

banner_collapse.description: Collapses the text of the notice again.

banner_service_label.message: AI service named by the developer:
banner_service_label.description: Precedes a product name inserted as data, untranslated.

banner_ignore.description: Button that stops badges and this notice for one game. Avoid the word the store uses for its own ignore feature.

banner_ignored.description: Replaces the notice after "Stop marking this game".

banner_region_label.description: Screen reader name for the one-line note shown instead of the notice.

notice_marking_stopped.description: Screen reader announcement after "Stop marking this game".

notice_marking_restored.description: Screen reader announcement after "Undo" or "Mark again".

notice_settings_saved.description: Screen reader announcement after a setting changes.

error_settings_save.message: Could not save this change. Try again.
error_settings_save.description: Under a setting whose change failed to save.

error_settings_load.message: Could not load your settings. Showing the defaults.
error_settings_load.description: Top of the settings page when stored settings cannot be read.

error_allow_list_save.message: Could not update this game. Try again.
error_allow_list_save.description: After "Stop marking this game", "Undo" or "Mark again" fails to save.

options_version.description: Under the product name at the top of the settings page and popup. $version$ is the release version, such as 2026.10.20; keep it as is.

options_badges.message: Badges on games that disclose AI use

options_badges_short.description: The same switch in the toolbar popup, where space is tight.

options_badges_help.message: Adds "$full$" to search and wishlist rows and "$compact$" to game images.
options_badges_help.description: Help under the badges switch. $full$ and $compact$ are the two badge labels.

options_banner_help.message: Shows the developer's disclosure above the purchase box.

options_filter_label.description: Label of a three-way choice: show, dim or hide these games in lists.

options_filter_off.description: Leave these games as they are.

options_filter_off_help.message: Lists stay as they are, apart from badges.

options_filter_dim_help.message: Fades these games in lists. Hover to see one clearly.

options_filter_hide_help.message: Removes these games from lists. Where hiding would break a list, they are dimmed instead.

options_language_auto.description: First entry of the language picker.

options_language_help.message: Automatic follows the store page's language when a translation exists, and English otherwise.

options_allow_since.description: Under a game you stopped marking. $date$ is already formatted for the locale.

options_allow_restore.description: Button next to a game you stopped marking.

options_allow_restore_label.description: Screen reader name of the "Mark again" button; $name$ is the game's name, untranslated.

options_allow_empty.message: None yet. Use "$action$" on a game page.
options_allow_empty.description: Shown when no game is in the list. $action$ is the "Stop marking this game" label.

options_privacy_no_reports.message: Sends no reports. It only reads the disclosures developers made on Steam.
options_privacy_no_reports.description: Privacy bullet: the product never reports games or users anywhere; it only shows what developers disclosed to Steam.

options_privacy_storage.message: Settings and results stay in this browser.

options_privacy_lookup.message: To check a game, it asks Valve's own store servers, without your cookies or account.

options_privacy_nothing_sent.message: Nothing is sent to us or anyone else. No analytics.

options_unaffiliated.message: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Valve Corporation. Steam is a trademark of Valve Corporation.
options_unaffiliated.description: Legal line at the bottom of the settings; keep the names as they are.

options_unaffiliated_short.message: Not affiliated with Valve. Nothing leaves your browser except lookups to Valve's store.

options_all_settings.description: Link in the toolbar popup footer that opens the full settings page in a tab.
